user.title: HA Operator
user.description: Create HA Operator, then add resources, policies, and airflow requirements. New resources remain in observe mode until you explicitly select live.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HA Operator integration is needed.

user.title: Add resource
user.description: Choose physical outputs and independent feedback. Resources start in observe mode. Relay profiles must specify every output and include an all-off profile. Native fans require a default target object; relay fans require a default profile target object. See the examples in the documentation.

storage_error.title: HA Operator cannot trust saved intent
storage_error.description: Actuation is inhibited because saved intent could not be read, validated, or saved reliably. Preserve a copy of the ha_operator.*.json snapshot in your Home Assistant configuration directory before making changes. Check disk space, file permissions, and the Home Assistant logs. Restore a known-good snapshot if the file is corrupt; do not discard accepted intent to hide the fault. After resolving the storage problem, select Reload from the HA Operator integration menu. The repair clears only after saved intent loads successfully.

configuration_error.title: HA Operator configuration needs repair
configuration_error.description: Control is stopped because the configuration is invalid: {detail}. Reconfigure or remove the policies and airflow requirements that reference a deleted resource; do not delete unrelated configuration. Then select Reload from the HA Operator integration menu. Native deletion remains available while setup is stopped. Existing accepted intent is preserved, and this repair clears once the configuration validates.

configuration_error.message: Invalid HA Operator configuration: {detail}. Correct the configuration and reload the integration.

request.name: Request control
request.description: Durably accept a manual target or hands-off lease for one live resource.

resource_id.name: Resource ID
resource_id.description: Resource subentry ID. Choose this or a managed resource entity, not both. Leave both empty only to explain or reconcile every resource.

entity_id.name: Managed resource entity
entity_id.description: The managed cover, fan, or switch belonging to one resource. Choose this or Resource ID, not both.

target.name: Requested target
target.description: Target object with position, on, percentage, direction, or a configured fan profile. Required in target mode; omit for hands-off mode.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Lease duration in seconds. Omit to use the resource manual duration; choose only one of duration, absolute expiry, or until released.

expires_at.name: Absolute expiry
expires_at.description: UTC Unix timestamp in seconds. The occurrence or manual lease cannot dispatch after this deadline.

indefinite.name: Until released
indefinite.description: Hold manual ownership until explicitly released. Do not combine with duration or absolute expiry.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse only for retries of identical intent.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: Optional entry selector. Defaults to the single HA Operator integration.
